title: The seal-evaluation validator selects the newest evaluation at the completion cut
outcome: The shared seal-to-evaluation check requires the bound evaluation to be the newest on the run feed at the completion cut, so an older pass cannot be bound over a newer blocking verdict; this is integrity coverage, not an ordinary done bypass
acceptance: a_seal_binding_an_older_pass_under_a_newer_blocking_evaluation_is_refused passes: a seal re-frozen to bind an older passing evaluation while a newer fail or needs_human evaluation sits at or before the completion cut is reported by doctor under the binding label, refused by the provenance read, and refused at completion; a healthy evaluated completion and an evaluation appended after the cut remain valid

completion.summary: The shared seal-to-evaluation check now requires the bound evaluation to be the newest on the run feed at the completion cut (newest_evaluation_through; reason "is not the newest evaluation on the run feed at the completion cut"), ordered after the all-pass check so every prior reason stands. Pinned by a_seal_binding_an_older_pass_under_a_newer_blocking_evaluation_is_refused (newer fail and needs_human; healthy control; post-cut exclusion; doctor label, shared-check refusal, unavailable provenance read) and an older-pass case in the per-relationship test; B36's re-freeze became a shared helper. RED logs/38c, GREEN logs/39 and 41; final sequence logs/42 all pass. Documented in the shared binding check paragraph and matrix row B48.
